T = N + K + 1
N_ = N * T + 1
M_ = K + (2 * M * K + N) * (T - 1)

INF = 10**9

pi = [0] * N_
kk = [0] * N_
bb = [0] * N_
pq = [0] * (N_ + 1)
iq = [0] * N_
cnt = 0

def i2(i):
    i *= 2
    if i > cnt:
        return 0
    if i < cnt and (pi[pq[i + 1]] < pi[pq[i]] or (pi[pq[i + 1]] == pi[pq[i]] and kk[pq[i + 1]] < kk[pq[i]])):
        return i + 1
    return i

def pq_up(u):
    global cnt
    i = iq[u]
    while i > 1:
        j = i // 2
        if pi[u] < pi[pq[j]] or (pi[u] == pi[pq[j]] and kk[u] < kk[pq[j]]):
            pq[iq[pq[j]]] = i
            pq[i] = pq[j]
            iq[u] = j
            iq[pq[j]] = j
            i = j
        else:
            break
    pq[i] = u
    iq[u] = i

def pq_dn(u):
    global cnt
    i = iq[u]
    while True:
        j = i2(i)
        if j == 0:
            break
        if pi[pq[j]] < pi[u] or (pi[pq[j]] == pi[u] and kk[pq[j]] < kk[u]):
            pq[iq[pq[j]]] = i
            pq[i] = pq[j]
            iq[u] = j
            iq[pq[j]] = j
            i = j

    pq[i] = u
    iq[u] = i

def pq_add(u):
    global cnt
    cnt += 1
    iq[u] = cnt
    pq_up(u)

def pq_remove_first():
    global cnt
    u = pq[1]
    v = pq[cnt]
    cnt -= 1
    iq[v] = 1
    pq_dn(v)
    return u

class Link:
    def __init__(self, j, next_node=None):
        self.j = j
        self.next = next_node

aa = [None for _ in range(N)]
aa_ = [None for _ in range(N_)]
l_pool = []

def add(i, j):
    global l_pool
    l = Link(j, aa[i])
    aa[i] = l
    l_pool.append(l)

def add_(i, h):
    global l_pool
    l = Link(h, aa_[i])
    aa_[i] = l
    l_pool.append(l)

n_ = 0
m_ = 0
uu = [0] * (M_ * 2)
vv = [0] * (M_ * 2)
uv = [0] * (M_ * 2)
cost = [0] * (M_ * 2)
cost_ = [0] * (M_ * 2)
cc = [0] * (M_ * 2)

def link(u, v, cap, cos):
    global n_, m_
    h = m_
    m_ += 1
    uu[h] = u
    vv[h] = v
    uv[h] = u ^ v
    cost[h] = cos
    cc[h * 2] = cap
    add_(u, h * 2)
    add_(v, h * 2 ^ 1)

def dijkstra(s):
    for i in range(n_):
        pi[i] = INF
        kk[i] = 0
        bb[i] = 0
    pi[s] = 0
    global cnt
    cnt = 0
    pq.clear()
    pq.extend([0] * (N_ + 1))
    pq_add(s)
    while cnt > 0:
        u = pq_remove_first()
        l = aa_[u]
        while l:
            h_ = l.j
            l = l.next
            h = h_ >> 1
            v = u ^ uv[h]
            if cc[h_]:
                p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 and cost[h] or -cost[h])
                if pi[v] == INF:
                    pi[v] = p
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v] = h_
                    pq_add(v)
                elif pi[v] > p or (pi[v] == p and kk[v] > kk[u] + 1):
                    pi[v] = p
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v] = h_
                    pq_up(v)

def push(s, t):
    u = t
    while u != s:
        h_ = bb[u]
        h = h_ >> 1
        cc[h_] -= 1
        cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
        u ^= uv[h]

def edmonds_karp(s, t):
    for i in range(m_):
        cost_[i] = cost[i]
    while True:
        dijkstra(s)
        if pi[t] == INF:
            break
        push(s, t)
        for h in range(m_):
            u = uu[h]
            v = vv[h]
            if pi[u] != INF and pi[v] != INF:
                cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v]
    c_total = 0
    for h in range(m_):
        c_total += cost[h] * cc[h * 2 ^ 1]
    return c_total
